notes.title: Liminal Border Part III
notes.notes:
[h3]The store page for Liminal Border Part III is now open![/h3]
[h1]Wishlist now ➡[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3094040/Liminal_Border_Part_III/

[h3]ABOUT THIS GAME[/h3]
Following the events of Part II, Itsuki and the gang's "Rave" business is close to getting off the ground. Itsuki looks to Meryl Hathaway, a young girl often seen accompanying Kotoko, as a counter to the violence of the Umon-kai as he searches for a way to destroy them once and for all.
